shootVelocity.description: Velocity of the launched bubble. Lower velocities increase travel time and allow more deliberate strategy, whereas higher values speed up shooting.

aimGuideEnabled.description: Enables or disables the aiming guide and bounce indicators. 1: Enabled (provides full trajectory line), 0: Disabled (hides aiming assistance completely).

bubbleLimitMultiplier.description: Scaling factor applied to the level's total shot limit. Higher values allow more mistakes, while lower values restrict total shots.
